current.long_term_thesis: QQQ provides concentrated exposure to the 100 largest non-financial Nasdaq companies, giving long-term investors a systematic stake in the world's most dominant technology and innovation-driven businesses. current.add_rationale: QQQ is not currently in the portfolio and deserves a core allocation for any growth-oriented long-term investor.
